verdict.rationale: The pack documents online split payments, balance accounts, payouts and reporting for platforms, but nothing on terminals, tap-to-pay SDKs, or in-person payments settling into seller balance accounts. The llms.txt probe only lists "point-of-sale" as a documentation topic on the same site. That does not show in-person payments flowing into platform seller balances and reporting, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder with offline sellers, in-person works on the same stack — terminals or tap-to-pay SDKs that settle into the same seller balances and reporting as online payments
